# @sharadox/pointer-web-library

> Pointer effects for React.

- /spotlight: useSpotlight<T>() → ref; sets --pointer-x/--pointer-y (px) on pointermove
- /tilt: useTilt<T>(maximum=8) → ref; sets --tilt-x/--tilt-y (deg); resets on leave; fine pointers only
- /cursor: <Cursor hotSelector grabSelector className /> dot + lagging ring, mix-blend difference; --cursor-color, --cursor-size; html gets class while active (hides system cursor)
- Peer: react. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
